about: Cases this desktop adds to the shared caller-asked check (../transfer-v1.caller-asked.fixture.json), which the phone plugin also runs and this desktop passes in full: requests to speak to a person that check does not count, and things a caller says that are not requests but that check lets through (it lists three of them as knownGaps). The named block needs the owner name the business is named for. Not part of the set shared with the phone plugin.
